summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting routine corporate governance changes: appointment of Howard Steinberg as Chief Legal Officer (effective July 22, 2026), appointment of Keren Maimon as Managing Director (same date), and mutual termination of an Advisory Services agreement with Pulsar Group Ltd. effective July 29, 2026, with no cost or obligation. No strategic transaction, shareholder vote, or financial terms are disclosed. The appointments and advisory agreement termination are ordinary operational matters, not special-situations events. The termination is mutual under a contractual provision and lacks deal-related significance.
